scope: Corollary 7.2 (Abundance after nonvanishing over characteristic-zero fields) of the manuscript “Lifting sections from the reduced support of an adjoint” (preprints/Lifting-sections-from-the-reduced-support-of-an-adjoint-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 034 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ecbc1b8c73fefb32), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 29. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (X, ∆) be a projective lc rational pair of dimension at most four over an algebraically closed field k of characteristic zero. Suppose that D = KX + ∆ is Q-Cartier and nef and κ(X, D) ≥ 0. Then D is semiample, and if κ(X, D) = 0, then D ∼Q 0.
